SELECT w.w_state, i.i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date < CAST('2001-05-02' AS date) THEN cs.cs_sales_price * COALESCE(cr_agg.cnt, 1) - COALESCE(cr_agg.sum_refund, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN d.d_date >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS date) THEN cs.cs_sales_price * COALESCE(cr_agg.cnt, 1) - COALESCE(cr_agg.sum_refund, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales cs
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = cs.cs_item_sk
JOIN warehouse w ON cs.cs_warehouse_sk = w.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN (SELECT d_date_sk, d_date FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS date) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS date)) AS d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
LEFT JOIN (SELECT cr_order_number, cr_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(cr_refunded_cash) AS sum_refund FROM catalog_returns GROUP BY cr_order_number, cr_item_sk) AS cr_agg ON cs.cs_order_number = cr_agg.cr_order_number AND cs.cs_item_sk = cr_agg.cr_item_sk
WHERE i.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
ORDER BY w.w_state, i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
